item.title: How to Merge local-lvm and local into a Single Storage in Proxmox
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to merging the local-lvm and local storages in Proxmox into a single logical storage. Covers the commands and settings that help you use space more efficiently and simplify management of virtual machines and containers.
